about: The flights sw/sim/scorecard.py scores, found in sw/recordings by its inventory (scorecard.py --inventory writes models/scorecard/inventory.json): every drone 1 recording inside a configuration's from-until (recording-name prefixes, until exclusive) whose motors ran and that left the ground, unless excluded below with its reason. A configuration is what changed physically between sessions and what the scorecard sets per flight from it: bands (true: the rubber bands pulling both assemblies forward, the plant's own preload or burst_replay.BANDS, the tilt 2.5 degrees behind its command and the accelerometer reading 0.025 g forward, as flip.py and sweep.py have them; false: left_band and right_band 0; "plant": the plant's own band terms and no offset), table (the motors' thrust against throttle: firmware is the firmware's own table, which the old ESCs flew to 2026-11-12; stand is the 2026-11-14 thrust stand's on the Nuofany 40A ESCs fitted for 2026-11-14 on, flip_esc.STAND), hull (what it rests on: legs, the forward legs since 2026-11-11, takeoff_test.LEG_FEET; belly, legless 2026-11-07 to 11-10, rigid.HULL; feet, the first legs, sweep.FEET) and, for the drone before its pivots were raised on 2026-11-11 (history: scored apart from the total), geometry (the plant's coefficients at that geometry, as airframe.py means a chassis change to work) and plant (the model fitted then, --plant era). excluded (a reason) leaves a whole configuration out. kind is the configuration's unless flights gives another; flights also gives windows (s from the recording's first sample: only the start points inside are scored) and notes. Each flight's thrust trim, its steady pushes and its mass's share of the thrust are the flight's own (scorecard.py). Times are UTC (the recordings' names); Pacific is 8 h behind. training lists the recordings each plant was fitted on (its own and its parents' fits, by name prefix), for the held-out totals.

kinds.landing: every whole-flight entry's last 2.5 s with the motors on when it landed (the touchdown and any tip-over in the horizon), pooled
kinds.hop: short flights (under 5 s airborne) that the configuration's hover kind would otherwise get: the 2026-11-15 03:48-04:09 hops at 0.5 m that tipped, hops cut at the tilt limit
kinds.cut: every whole-flight entry's last 2.5 s with the motors on when it did not land (stopped by the pilot or the tilt limit: the tip-overs), pooled
